column2: A clown performs a playful exaggerated bow while juggling scarves at a small street show, making nearby children laugh.
A cozy coffee house has a barista pouring coffee behind a counter and two customers seated at a small window table.
A cook follows a picture-only recipe while measuring ingredients and stirring a saucepan on a kitchen worktop.
Two Japanese travelers greet each other warmly abroad, their travel bags each carrying a small white flag with a red circle.
A student crams for an examination at a crowded desk, studying several open books late beside a small lamp.
A persistently ringing alarm drives an exasperated adult to clutch the head while papers and unfinished work cover the desk.
A crossword puzzle grid has interlocking white word spaces and black squares, with a pencil resting across the unfinished page.
A celebrated performer reaches a triumphant peak at a packed concert, receiving flowers as the audience rises to applaud.
A pair of scissors lies beside a cleanly cut paper butterfly and the matching butterfly-shaped hole in the original sheet.
A dachshund stands side-on with a long low body, short legs, drooping ears and a gently curved tail.
A dying elderly person rests peacefully in bed as family members sit close and hold the person's hand.
A carpenter discovers a serious crack in a finished chair leg, pointing at the defect while the chair stands unevenly.
A demonstrator joins a peaceful street march, holding a plain raised placard while walking with other concerned citizens.
A descendent leaf drifts downward from a high branch, its curved path ending near fallen leaves on the ground.
A teacher speaks slowly to a listening student who writes the dictated sounds into a notebook, with no readable words shown.
A sandy-colored dingo stands alert beside dry Australian scrub, showing upright ears, a narrow muzzle and a bushy tail.
A child displeases a gardener by trampling a freshly planted flower bed, while the gardener looks visibly upset.
A visitor presses a small doorbell button beside a front door, while the bell mechanism inside the doorway visibly vibrates.
A careless carrier drops one egg from a basket, with the falling egg just above the kitchen floor.
A resident waters plants at the open window of a small apartment, with a lived-in room visible behind.
A candle has dwindled to a short stump beside its pool of melted wax, while a tiny flame remains.
A musician returns toward the stage after a bow as the audience keeps applauding and eagerly waves the performer back.
An engraver cuts a small flower pattern into a metal plate using a pointed tool held steadily against the surface.
A street entertainer performs a lively puppet act for a small semicircle of smiling spectators.
An eyewitness points out a fallen bicycle to an investigating officer while the cyclist receives help nearby.
A group of children eagerly play with matching new spinning toys, while discarded older novelty toys lie unused beside their bags.
A simple metal clasp fastens two ends of a leather strap together, with the hooked locking parts clearly visible.
A close view of a relaxed hand shows one neatly trimmed fingernail with its pale free edge and smooth curved surface.
A fingertip gently touches a tiny smooth pebble, emphasizing the soft rounded end and fine skin ridges.
A curved fishing hook has a sharp barbed tip, a small eye and a short line tied through it.
A narrow footpath winds through grass between two hedges, with a walker following it toward a small gate.
A child exclaims in surprise on discovering an enormous pumpkin beneath a vine, eyes wide and both hands lifted.
A person points to the chin directly below the lower lip, with the chin region gently highlighted in teal.
A gnu stands on a grassy plain, showing a dark beard, curved horns, high shoulders and slender hindquarters.
A golfer swings a club toward a white ball on a short tee, with the entire club and follow-through visible.
A fluffy yellow-gray gosling walks beside its parent goose near the edge of a pond.
A motor grader levels a rough gravel road with a long angled blade mounted beneath its extended frame.
A metal box grater stands beside a block of cheese and a small mound of freshly grated shreds.
A vegetable grower carefully tends rows of young plants in a greenhouse, carrying a watering can between the beds.
A delighted diner savors a warm fruit tart, eyes closed in enjoyment and a small fork poised above the plate.
A cook halves an apple cleanly through its center, with two equal halves resting together on the cutting board.
A craftsperson stitches the final seam of a handmade leather pouch, with a needle, thread and cut leather nearby.
A child plays a harmonica held between both hands at the mouth, with cheeks gently drawn inward.
Senior teammates subject an exhausted newcomer to harsh extra drills while a concerned bystander moves to intervene.
A masked hijacker threatens a bus driver from beside the steering wheel while frightened passengers remain seated; no injury or gore.
A holly sprig has dark glossy spiny-edged leaves and a compact cluster of round red berries.
Survivors mourn beside a large row of fully covered civilian bodies in a ruined village as armed attackers retreat; no gore.
A householder stands at the doorway holding house keys while inspecting a repaired fence on the surrounding property.
A blue-hued ceramic vase holds white flowers, with its rich blue glaze covering the entire rounded body.
A cheering spectator throws both arms upward as a runner crosses a finish line, mouth open in a triumphant shout.
A red fire hydrant stands beside a curb, with two capped side outlets and a large top operating nut.
A spotted hyena stands on dry grass, displaying rounded ears, powerful shoulders and a back sloping toward the hindquarters.
Long clear icicles hang from the edge of a snowy roof, with one melting drop forming at a pointed tip.
A sealed shipping crate is in transit on the back of a delivery truck moving along a road toward a warehouse.
A translucent incorporeal spirit floats above the floor, with the room's chair and curtain visible through its body.
A handheld infrared camera displays a person's warm silhouette in red and orange against a cooler blue room, without numbers or labels.
An inside-out sweater lies on a table with its seams and fabric reverse exposed, one sleeve still partly turned.
A cream card shows only the sample letters “abc” in clearly slanted italic type beside a small printer's composing tool.
A colorful jack-in-the-box springs from an open cube on a coiled metal spring while a surprised child leans back.
A joystick has a short upright control stick, a rounded grip and a broad base fitted with a few plain buttons.
A dishonest shell-game operator secretly palms a small ball while distracting the watching player with the other hand.
A kayaker paddles a narrow kayak through calm water, holding a double-bladed paddle across the cockpit.
A cook cools a steaming bowl of soup by resting it inside a wider basin of cold water and stirring gently.
Two children pass a ball between them while a third child in the middle tries unsuccessfully to intercept it.
A large kelp frond rises from a rocky holdfast, with long brown blades and small buoyant floats along the stem.
A deep round ladle lifts soup from a stockpot, with its long handle resting above the rim.
A red ladybug with black spots rests on a green leaf, showing six tiny legs and short antennae.
A landowner inspects a newly repaired boundary fence with a survey plan tucked beneath one arm and the field beyond.
A ring-tailed lemur sits on a branch, with bright eyes, a pointed muzzle and its long striped tail hanging below.
A lifeboat carries rescued passengers away from a damaged ship, with life jackets and an oarsman clearly visible.
A llama stands on a rocky hillside, displaying a long neck, upright curved ears and thick shaggy wool.
A small police lock-up contains a barred cell door, a simple bench and an officer supervising from outside.
A designer sketches an original simple three-leaf logo on a card beside a plain package bearing the same nonverbal emblem.
A round striped lollipop stands upright on a white stick, with its twisted wrapper opened beside it.
A public-address loudspeaker has a wide flared horn mounted on a bracket above a small outdoor gathering.
A magnified louse clings to a strand of hair, showing six clawed legs and a flattened segmented body.
A cat lurks behind a low wall with its body crouched and eyes fixed on a mouse approaching the corner.
A shadowy nightmare spirit crouches above a sleeping adult, whose tense expression and clenched blanket show a frightening dream.
A small tub of pale margarine stands open beside a bread slice spread with a smooth yellow layer.
A glass jar of orange marmalade shows thin strips of peel suspended in the preserve, with a spoon resting beside it.
A mastodon with shaggy brown hair and long curved tusks stands beside low conifer branches, shown as an extinct elephant relative.
A student closes a studied book and recites from memory, counting points on the fingers while a classmate listens.
A meteorologist compares a cloud model with observations through a weather-station window, beside a rain gauge and wind instrument.
A milkman carries a crate of glass milk bottles toward a doorstep where two empty bottles wait.
A continuous ticket strip emerges from a dispenser bearing only the serials “999998”, “999999” and a gold-highlighted final “1000000”.
A sleek brown mink stands near a stream, showing a long narrow body, small ears and short legs.
A thick oven mitt rests beside a warm baking tray, showing its separate thumb section and padded fabric.
A long stone mole extends from a harbor shore into the sea, sheltering small boats behind its solid wall.
A motorbike stands on its kickstand, showing an engine, fuel tank, exhaust pipe and two substantial wheels.
A small motorboat moves across a lake, with an outboard motor at the stern leaving a foamy wake.
A wild mustang trots across open grassland, with an untrimmed mane, alert ears and no saddle or tack.
A nautilus swims with its striped spiral shell behind a cluster of short tentacles around the head.
A glowing nebula forms a broad cloud of pink and blue gas around several bright stars in dark space.
A negotiator sits between two disputing parties and calmly brings their proposed arrangements together across one table.
A small newt rests beside a pond, showing a slender moist body, four short legs and a long tapering tail.
A noiseless electric cart glides past a sleeping cat without disturbing it, with smooth wheels and no exhaust.
A nutria sits beside reeds, showing large orange front teeth, a rounded body and a long bare tail.
A tall stone obelisk rises from a square base, with four tapering sides ending in a small pyramidal tip.
A black-and-white orca surfaces beside a low wave, displaying a tall dorsal fin and a white eye patch.
An oryx stands on sandy ground, showing a pale body, dark facial markings and two long straight horns.
An ornamental oval brooch fastens the collar of a cloak, with a visible pin clasp behind its setting.
A host overdoes the decorations on a tiny cake, piling it with an excessive tower of ribbons and ornaments.
A paleontologist carefully brushes soil from an exposed fossil skeleton at a marked excavation site.
A passer-by pauses on a sidewalk to help gather papers that a stranger has dropped in the wind.
A fiery phoenix rises above a small bed of cooling ashes, with broad red-gold wings and a long glowing tail.
A large pile-up of cardboard boxes blocks a storeroom doorway, with several parcels balanced precariously on top.
A brown pine cone lies beside a pine twig, with overlapping woody scales clearly opening around its axis.
A child's paper pinwheel turns on a short stick, with four folded colored vanes attached at the center.
A person hides a small money pouch beneath a loose floor plank, carefully lowering the board back into place.
A plumed hat has a large soft feather attached beside its band, with the feather's barbs spreading gently outward.
A plain orange ice pop on a wooden stick stands beside its peeled-back wrapper, with a few small melting drops.
A postgraduate researcher studies a specimen through a microscope, with a graduation cap and closed diploma case on the nearby shelf.
A baked pretzel has a glossy brown twisted loop shape and a light scattering of coarse salt.
A bird prunes its feathers by drawing a wing feather gently through its beak while perched on a branch.
A professional boxer trains inside a boxing ring, punching a coach's raised mitts while wearing padded gloves.
An athlete performs an overhand pull-up, gripping a horizontal bar with palms facing away and chin lifted above it.
A punctual visitor arrives at a meeting doorway as the clock's minute hand reaches the appointed mark and the host opens the door.
A butterfly pupa hangs from a small twig, with its rigid green casing and attachment point clearly visible.
A distant quasar has an intensely bright galactic core surrounded by a luminous accretion disk and two narrow opposing jets.
A bunch of red radishes has round red roots, thin white tips and fresh leafy green tops.
A sealed glass sample vial contains a tiny silvery radium specimen inside a protective display case, marked only with the chemical symbol “Ra”.
A horse ramps onto its hind legs with forelegs raised, while the handler stays safely to one side holding the lead.
A child gathers scattered marbles again into the same cloth bag, reaching for the last few beneath a table.
A cashier refunds a customer by returning coins across the counter beside the returned item and its plain receipt.
A tall coastal redwood rises through a green forest, with deeply furrowed reddish bark and a tiny walker near its base.
A roadrunner runs along a dry desert path, showing a long tail, raised crest and strong legs.
A red-colored silk ribbon curls across a pale worktable, with its richly red surface catching a soft highlight.
A sliced salami sausage rests on a wooden board, revealing a pink-red interior dotted with small white fat pieces.
A child shapes a sand castle with towers, a shallow moat and a shell-lined entrance beside a small bucket.
A sponge becomes saturated as water fills every pore and drips steadily from its lower edge into a basin.
A small schoolhouse has an entrance porch, classroom windows and children arriving with school bags along the path.
A male schoolteacher explains a simple geometric model to seated pupils while holding the model above the desk.
A sheer curtain is see-through, allowing the outline of a window frame and a potted plant behind it to remain visible.
Four tennis players contest two semifinal matches on adjoining courts, with a single championship trophy waiting beyond the central walkway.
A farmer leaves one fenced field fallow, with natural ground cover growing there while planted crop rows occupy the neighboring field.
A chief dining steward directs two servers carrying covered platters toward a formally laid long dining table.
An athlete performs a sit-up on a floor mat with bent knees, lifting the upper body toward the thighs.
A car skids sideways on a wet bend, with its tires sliding across the road and the driver gripping the wheel.
A skier descends a snowy slope with bent knees, holding two poles and keeping both skis parallel.
A fencer slashes diagonally at a suspended practice target with a training sword, without wounds or blood.
A snob ignores a modest handmade present while proudly displaying an expensive-looking jeweled watch to impressed companions.
Soapy water fills a basin with white foam as two hands rub a bar of soap above the bubbles.
